अखट्टः [खट्ट्-अच् न. त.] N. of a
tree (प्रियाल) Buchanania Latifolia.

अखट्टिः m. f. [खट्ट्-इ, न. त. वा ङीप्] Bad
conduct (अशिष्टव्यवहार); a childish
freak or whim.

अखंडन a. [न खंड्यते निरवयवत्वात्; खंड्
--ल्युट् न. त.]
1 Unbroken, not
capable of being broken or divided,
epithet of परमात्मन्.
--2 Full, entire.
--नं [न. त.]
1 Not breaking, leaving
entire.
--2 Non-refutation.
--नः Time.

अखंडित a. [न. त.]
1 Unbroken,
undivided.
--2 Uninterrupted,
perpetual, undisturbed, continuous; ˚ता
मे वाणिज्या

everlasting,
unbroken.
--3 Unimpaired; unrefuted &c;
भट्टिन्या अखंडितात् प्रणयात्

whose prowess knows no repulse
or defeat.
--Comp.
--उत्सव a. always
festive.
--ऋतुः [अखंडितः ऋतुः तत्संपत्
पुष्पादिप्रसवरूपा यत्र] time or season
which yields its usual produce of
flowers &c. (a.) fruitful, bearing fruit
in due season.

अखात a. [न. त.] Not dug; not
buried.
--तः --तं A natural lake or
pool of water; a bay; especially a
pool before a temple.

अख्खल ind. An exclamation of
joy; ˚लीकृ to utter this exclamation.

आखण a. Hard(to dig up)
(as a stone).
